purpose: Preserve source-referenced current evidence prospectively before future <=90-day price paths are known, without claiming candidate/ranking authority before authentic historical matched-control validation.

freshness_rationale.stable_identity: Identity changes slowly but must be re-attested at least monthly for a current snapshot.
freshness_rationale.venue_membership: Listing/trading availability is fast-moving and must be observed within one hour of the cutoff.
freshness_rationale.liquidity_proxy: Trailing liquidity statistics must end on data no older than one day at the cutoff.
freshness_rationale.strict_tradability: Matches the frozen #519 maximum microstructure snapshot age of 60 minutes.
freshness_rationale.spot_participation_flow: Intraday participation/flow evidence older than six hours is not treated as current.
freshness_rationale.leverage_state: Funding/OI/basis state is fast-moving and must be observed within one hour.
freshness_rationale.supply_float: Supply/float is slower-moving but must be re-attested within seven days.
freshness_rationale.catalyst_state: Catalyst state must be refreshed within one day because implementation/invalidations can change.
freshness_rationale.market_regime: Market regime must be observed within six hours.
freshness_rationale.relationship_graph: Slow-moving graph edges must still be re-attested within thirty days.

strict_tradability_binding.rule: A STRICT_TRADABLE value must be recomputable against the exact pinned #519 contract at one frozen execution band; a caller-authored string, ADV proxy, or unverified receipt cannot establish strict tradability.

snapshot_semantics.information_cutoff: All KNOWN evidence must have observed_at <= available_at <= captured_at <= information_cutoff and satisfy the frozen family-specific freshness policy. The snapshot is committed only after the cutoff; later evidence is forbidden from the same snapshot identity.
snapshot_semantics.unknown_policy: Every frozen feature family must be present. Unavailable evidence is recorded as UNKNOWN with a precise reason; it is never imputed or silently omitted.
snapshot_semantics.receipt_policy: Each KNOWN record carries raw_sha256, receipt_sha256 and receipt_kind. MECHANISM_REVIEW_READY additionally requires each mandatory receipt SHA-256 to be supplied out-of-band from an independently verified source-specific trusted boundary; UNVERIFIED_RESEARCH_RECEIPT cannot satisfy readiness.
snapshot_semantics.tradability_policy: STRICT_TRADABLE must be a structured result bound to exact 2X-TRADABILITY-001-v1 Git blob 525b6a794e763569fbc9430f70fc725b10388b85, an explicit frozen USD execution band, PIT spread/depth/VWAP metrics and trusted receipt verification. Liquidity/ADV alone cannot substitute.
snapshot_semantics.snapshot_time_policy: created_at and information_cutoff are self-reported research fields. The local snapshot digest is not non-backdateable proof that the snapshot existed pre-move. Any prospective outcome study or #506 formation must first bind the snapshot to a trusted append-only/server-time receipt.
snapshot_semantics.current_survivor_policy: This contract does not define a universe from today's survivors. Any current retrieval universe must itself be frozen and source-authenticated before asset snapshots are interpreted as a population.
snapshot_semantics.selection_policy: MECHANISM_REVIEW_READY means only that fresh mandatory evidence is present, independently verified receipt hashes were supplied out-of-band, and strict tradability passes the exact pinned #519 contract at the declared band. It is not a rank, calibrated probability, 2x forecast, prospective chronology proof, or formation authorization.

evidence_argument_policy.binding: Each argument references the SHA-256 of a frozen feature-family record in the same asset snapshot.

explicit_non_authorities: No snapshot can be backfilled as a prediction after a move.
No probability, rank score, profitability, or predictive-lift claim is authorized by this contract.
A local snapshot digest is not non-backdateable prospective proof; trusted append-only/server-time persistence is required before outcome comparison or #506 formation.

No forward formation may be persisted until source receipts are independently verified and the selection mechanism clears authentic historical matched-control validation or another separately reviewed evidence gate.
Zero live candidates is a valid result.
